# MS NOW: My source \| News \| Opinion \| World

> MS NOW \(formerly MSNBC\): Breaking news and the latest headlines today\. Get daily updates from local reporters plus world news with live audio and video\.

Generated by Yoast SEO v28.5, this is an llms.txt file, meant for consumption by LLMs.

## Pages
- [Homepage New](https://www.ms.now/)
- [Elections](https://www.ms.now/elections)
- [Know Your Value](https://www.ms.now/knowyourvalue)
- [Never Worry Alone with Dan Harris](https://www.ms.now/never-worry-alone)
- [Rachel Maddow Show](https://www.ms.now/rachel-maddow-show)

## Articles
- [Wednesday’s Campaign Round\-Up, 11\.11\.26: Fetterman rivals already eyeing 2028 primary](https://www.ms.now/rachel-maddow-show/maddowblog/fetterman-primary-pennsylvania-congress-leadership-races-thune-schumer): Today’s installment of campaign\-related news items from across the country\.
- [Democrats respond to whistleblowers’ allegations of Trump administration document destruction](https://www.ms.now/rachel-maddow-show/maddowblog/interior-whistleblowers-oversight-house-natural-resources-committee): Interior Department officials have reportedly destroyed internal documents in anticipation of congressional oversight\. Democrats are taking this seriously\.
- [Trump to speak at Arlington Cemetery as legal fight over arch intensifies](https://www.ms.now/news/trump-arlington-cemetery-veterans-day-as-legal-fight-over-arch-intensifies): The president will deliver Veterans Day remarks from the sacred burial ground, which has been at the heart of the fight over his planned 250\-foot arch\. 
- [Trump appoints new DOJ civil rights chief after Harmeet Dhillon’s rocky departure](https://www.ms.now/news/trump-doj-civil-rights-trainor-dhillon): Craig Trainor, currently a top housing official, is slated to take over a DOJ Civil Rights Division profoundly changed by his predecessor\. 
- [Trump’s Oval Office proclamation is simply embarrassing](https://www.ms.now/opinion/trump-oval-office-proclamation-landmark): A proclamation naming the Oval Office a historic landmark is odd for a lot of reasons — but it’s clearly meant only to mollify a tantrum\-prone president\.

- [Maine State Overview](https://www.ms.now/elections/2026-general/me/maine-election-results-midterms-ufb0)

## Liveblogs
- [Hegseth decries impeachment push as 'political spectacle' in rare press briefing](https://www.ms.now/liveblog/pete-hegseth-impeachment-press-conference-live-updates): The defense secretary defended U\.S\. military actions in Iran, Yemen and Venezuela at the center of a House Republican’s impeachment efforts\.
- [2026 midterm election aftermath: Republicans point fingers after Democratic landslide](https://www.ms.now/liveblog/midterms-who-won-senate-house-live-updates): President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance blamed the war with Iran for the blue wave that upended House and Senate control\.
- [Election 2026: Supreme Court denies Trump administration's bid to separate California ballots](https://www.ms.now/liveblog/2026-midterm-elections-voting-live-updates): Candidates make their final campaign pushes before voters hit the polls to determine control of the House and Senate\.
- [2026 midterm election takeaways: Democrats retake House and Senate in referendum on Trump](https://www.ms.now/liveblog/midterm-election-results-2026-live-updates): Democrat Abdul El\-Sayed beat Republican Mike Rogers in Michigan’s Senate race, while Democrat James Talarico defeated Ken Paxton to flip Texas’ GOP\-held seat\.
- [Second Michigan Senate debate: El\-Sayed vs\. Rogers takeaways](https://www.ms.now/liveblog/abdul-el-sayed-mike-rogers-second-michigan-senate-debate-live-updates): Democrat Abdul El\-Sayed and Republican Mike Rogers faced off in their Michigan Senate rematch, followed by Republican Sen\. Roger Marshall and Democrat Adam Hamilton in Kansas\. In Minnesota, Democrat Amy Klobuchar debated Republican Lisa Demuth in the governor’s race\.

## Videos
- [Carlos Eduardo Espina: 'This election fundamentally changed the map for 2028'](https://www.ms.now/morning-joe/watch/carlos-eduardo-espina-this-election-fundamentally-changed-the-map-for-2028-2520367171753): Campaign strategist Rebecca Katz and progressive Latino influencer and the founder and director of Migrantes Unidos Carlos Eduardo Espina join Morning Joe to discuss what Democrats should do after their midterm wins\. Katz says voters want to see progress in their wallets and urges Democrats to learn from the different campaigns that succeeded\. Espina argues immigration reform should be a top priority and says the path to victory in Texas runs through Latino voters\. They also discuss ideological diversity in the party and the need to deliver results\.
- [Trump honors veterans at Arlington National Cemetery](https://www.ms.now/ms-now/watch/trump-honors-veterans-at-arlington-national-cemetery-2520362563917): President Trump and Vice President Vance attended the wreath\-laying ceremony at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier in Arlington National Cemetery to honor veterans\.
- [Rep\. Boyle: 'Fully expect' Congress will revisit Hegseth impeachment in January if not beforehand](https://www.ms.now/state-of-play/watch/rep-boyle-fully-expect-congress-will-revisit-hegseth-impeachment-in-january-if-not-beforehand-2520363075817): The House GOP blocked the impeachment vote against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth after 11 Democrats missed it\. Also, some Democrats are speaking out against Hakeem Jeffries as House Speaker\. Rep\. Brendan Boyle \(D\-PA\) joins Peter Alexander to share his thoughts\.
- [Buttigieg: Time for ‘big swings\.’ New Democratic Congress eyes ambitious agenda\.](https://www.ms.now/the-briefing-with-jen-psaki/watch/buttigieg-time-for-big-swings-new-democratic-congress-eyes-ambitious-agenda-2520313411923): Former Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg talks with Jen Psaki about the big ideas and major reforms Democrats in the new Congress may take on, everything from Citizens United to the Electoral College\.
- [Why wouldn't the FBI tell Huang about the intel they had?](https://www.ms.now/money-power-politics/watch/why-wouldn-t-the-fbi-tell-huang-about-the-intel-they-had-2520357955526): There is growing fallout over Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy\. Trump claims he did not hear of the relationship before his trip to China, but new reporting from The New York Times contradicts that\. Senior Data Editor and Columnist for CT Insider Philip Bump, former Rep\. Max Rose and MS NOW Political Analyst Molly Jong\-Fast join Stephanie Ruhle to discuss\.

## Exclusive Videos
- [Behind the scenes on election night](https://www.ms.now/off-the-charts/watch/behind-the-scenes-on-election-night-2520198723785): What was it like to report on a historic midterm election? Come behind the scenes at MS NOW headquarters in Times Square on November 3rd, from poll close to the moment Democrats regained control of the Senate\.
- [Are artificial sweeteners actually healthier than sugar?](https://www.ms.now/myth-or-medicine/watch/are-artificial-sweeteners-actually-healthier-than-sugar-2520264259615): Artificial sweeteners are often more popular than the real thing\. But what does it mean when you see "zero sugar", "sugar free", or "diet" on a label? Internal medicine resident, Dr\. Joel Bervell breaks down the health risks behind the sugar substitutes\.
- [Rachel Maddow: In Conversation with Chris Hayes](https://www.ms.now/maddow-in-conversation-with/watch/rachel-maddow-in-conversation-with-chris-hayes-2520062531885): Rachel Maddow joins Chris Hayes to discuss her newest book "Department of Fire" at George Washington University in Washington\.
- [Afraid of a family feud this Thanksgiving? Michael Steele has got you covered\.](https://www.ms.now/the-parenting-shift/watch/afraid-of-a-family-feud-this-thanksgiving-michael-steele-has-got-you-covered-2519908419936): Michael Steele is back on “The Parenting Shift” with Dr\. Ann\-Louise Lockhart\! With the holiday season quickly approaching, The Chairman and Dr\. Lockhart provide helpful tips to survive divisive dinner table debates and politely swerve uncomfortable confrontations, so you can opt for pumpkin pie instead of a festive fight\.
- [Accountability without revenge – with Sebene Selassie](https://www.ms.now/the-week-in-sanity/watch/accountability-without-revenge-with-sebene-selassie-2519920195581): After the Democrats’ midterm victory, how can accountability be pursued without revenge? This week, meditation teacher and author Sebene Selassie joins Dan Harris to explore how to channel anger constructively, connect with the care beneath it and find a healthy balance with the news\.

## Full Episodes
- [The Weekend \- 10/11/26](https://www.ms.now/the-weekend/full-episode/the-weekend-10-11-26): Jonathan Capehart, Eugene Daniels, and Jackie Alemany set the agenda for Saturday, Sunday, and the week ahead; fresh analysis of the week's biggest events\.
- [PoliticsNation \- 10/11/26](https://www.ms.now/al-sharpton/politicsnation/full-episode/politicsnation-10-11-26): Rev\. Al Sharpton highlights important political stories and issues that require a national platform\.
- [Connect \- 10/11/26](https://www.ms.now/connect/full-episode/connect-10-11-26): Connect with Jacob Soboroff brings viewers closer to the news, people and conversations shaping America, forging a meaningful link between Soboroff, his audience and the communities at the center of the national dialogue\.
- [The Assignment \- 10/11/26](https://www.ms.now/the-assignment/full-episode/the-assignment-10-11-26): Antonia Hylton tackles everything from major breaking news and original, compelling reporting'
- [The Moment \- 11/10/26](https://www.ms.now/full-episode/the-moment-11-10-26): Katy Tur cuts through the noise with sharp political analysis, breaking news, and impactful interviews on the stories driving the national conversation\. All delivered in a smart, fast\-paced, conversational style\.

## Single Live Events

- [Rachel Maddow speaks with Chris Hayes about her new book](https://www.ms.now/live-events/rachel-maddow-in-conversation-with-chris-hayes-live-from-washington-dc): Rachel Maddow joins Chris Hayes to discuss her newest book "Department of Fate" live from Washington\.

## Video Episodes
- [Maddow: 'Todd Blanche Should be IMPEACHED'](https://www.ms.now/video-podcast/maddow-todd-blanche-should-be-impeached-2520205891596): “Due process is not something that you grant people because you like them,” Rachel Maddow reminded an audience at George Washington University\. This past weekend, she joined Chris to talk about her new book, “Department of Fate: The Promise, the Power, and the Collapse of America's Most Consequential Institution,” and to reflect on the ways in which President Trump has weaponized the Department to target political enemies\. The two also considered whether we can expect a return to the rule of law thanks to the midterms’ “blue wave\.”
- [Heather Cox Richardson: ‘VERY optimistic’ about a political TIDAL SHIFT and Trump accountability](https://www.ms.now/video-podcast/heather-cox-richardson-very-optimistic-about-a-political-tidal-shift-and-trump-accountability-2519136323604): On this episode of The Best People podcast, author and history professor Heather Cox Richardson joins Nicolle with lessons from American history to help contextualize the current state of the nation ahead of the midterms\. She draws from an idea that Americans seem to have “lost” since Reagan’s presidency — a determination to mend the government to fit the needs of its constituents\. As Election Day looms and President Trump’s priorities seem more and more out of touch with the needs of everyday Americans, Richardson encourages us to exercise the right to change our government when it no longer works to serve us: “The Constitution literally begins, ‘we the people,’ and we have the right to vote\. Instead of being afraid to vote, we should make them afraid to stop us from voting\.”
- ['Screwed up SO BAD': Nicolle and Tim Miller on GOP's FAILED mob tactics and what's coming for Trump](https://www.ms.now/video-podcast/screwed-up-so-bad-nicolle-and-tim-miller-on-gop-s-failed-mob-tactics-and-what-s-coming-for-trump-2519759427574): Tim Miller is still trying to process what he just witnessed on election night\. The last time the host of “The Bulwark Daily” podcast was on “The Best People,” he posed a question for an internally divided Democratic Party as they looked ahead to 2028: “What’s on your red hat?” If Tuesday night was any indication, they seem to be figuring it out\. Miller and Nicolle come together again to reflect on some of the most surprising and historic wins for Democrats in the 2026 midterms — victories largely brought on by a united effort against an increasingly erratic President Trump\. “You're gonna do the Reflecting Pool closing speech when gas prices are $5 a gallon?” Miller asks\. The two former Republicans discuss how the MAGA fallacy destroyed the Republican institution, the prospective end of Trump’s coalition and a future full of cautious — but earnest — optimism\. “The Democratic Party is gonna really look like the country, both demographically but also ideologically,” Miller says\.
- [GOP DEFEAT\! How Republicans "DUMMYmandered" themselves out of office](https://www.ms.now/video-podcast/gop-defeat-how-republicans-dummymandered-themselves-out-of-office-2519912003901): After what seems like years of defeat after defeat, Democrats are still reeling from this week’s midterms results\. The party has repainted the House, the Senate, and numerous Governor's mansions and state capitols blue\. But how did we get here? Chris invites MS NOW’s Director of Elections and Analytics, Kabir Khanna, to the show to answer all the election questions that have kept him up at night\. What was the defection rate for Republicans? Why did corruption finally resonate with voters? Can we consider any states red or blue anymore? And will life always be this sweet for the Democratic party?
- ['A good old\-fashioned ass whooping\!' Dems OBLITERATE the GOP](https://www.ms.now/video-podcast/a-good-old-fashioned-ass-whooping-dems-obliterate-the-gop-2519848003539): Instead of bringing just one friend onto the show to discuss the historic 2026 midterms, Symone and Eugene invited the whole groupchat\. Tune in to listen to what Vice President Kamala Harris – in her first public reaction to the results – DNC Chair Ken Martin, Michael Steele, Senator Lisa Blunt Rochester, Governors Wes Moore and Andy Beshear, Mayor Brandon Scott, SEIU President April Varrett, Jane Kleeb, pollster Terrance Woodbury, South Carolina State Representative Hamilton Grant, and Mike Smith, president of the House Majority PAC, all have to say about what they believe their mandate to be\. And detail the plans they’re already putting in motion, from investigations to trying to raise the federal minimum wage to building the infrastructure for 2028\.

- [Insistence over Resistance, with Stacey Abrams](https://www.ms.now/msnbc-podcast/the-blueprint/blueprint-insistence-resistance-stacey-abrams-rcna194581): With optimism and realism, Stacey Abrams lays out where Democrats should focus their energy\. And how to regroup for the next fight\.

Greg Casar \(D\-TX\) offers his prescription to Dems for winning back voters’ trust\.
